Since the right side is three-digit and the base is at least 10, the exponent must be \(2\).  
Let \(\Delta=a,\ \square=b,\ \bigcirc=c\). Then
\[
(10a+b)^2=101b+10c.
\]
The square is three-digit, so \(10a+b\le 31\). Also the units digit condition gives \(b^2\equiv b\pmod{10}\), so \(b\in\{1,5,6\}\). Checking these, only
\[
26^2=676
\]
works. Thus \(\Delta=\triangle=2,\ \square=6,\ \bigcirc=7\).

\[
\boxed{\Delta=\triangle=2,\ \square=6,\ \bigcirc=7}
\]
